name: Inquisitor: queue component review
summary: Review a reorderable editing queue for state, subscription and access bugs.
prompt: Review change.diff and the post-change src/Queue.jsx for Mossbasket's editing queue. Report actionable bugs introduced by the change, not style preferences. Do not fix or edit src/Queue.jsx. Write review.json as {"findings":[{"file":"src/Queue.jsx","line":1,"severity":"high","title":"Describe the bug and its impact"}]}, replacing the example with your findings and using positive integer line numbers from the post-change file. Do not install packages or use the network.
